## 3. Frequently Asked Questions
Heading Type: h2
Recommended Heading: Frequently Asked Questions

Rationale:
People want to see how a streak works before they install. This section shows it in one view.

Sub-Headings (H3). Bullets below each subheading are ready-to-use copy (can be implemented as paragraphs, bullets or any other text-style):

### Is Habitly Free to Try?
- Yes. Habitly is free to download and the streak tracker works without a subscription.

### Does the Habit Streak Tracker Work on Android?
- Yes. Habitly runs on iPhone and Android. Your streaks sync between the two.

### What Happens if I Miss a Day?
- Your streak resets to zero. Habitly keeps the old streak in your history.

### Can I Pause a Streak?
- Yes. Habitly lets you mark a rest day. A rest day does not break the streak.

### Can I Export My Streaks?
- Yes. Habitly exports your history as a CSV file. You can open it in any spreadsheet.

### Does Habitly Tell Me Which Habits to Build?
- No. Habitly records the habits you choose. It does not suggest new ones.

### How Accurate Are the Streak Counts?
- Habitly counts a day once you check the habit off. The count follows your phone's time zone.

CTA Recommendations:
- Get the App
